refuted_claims.claim: A negation or disjunction was lost from a Panic/Stress row, as happened in the previous project ('you or').
refuted_claims.why_wrong: Every 'you or' in a panic/stress/talent row survives, and a full negation audit across ST-J02..J10 (cannot/never/not/unless/only/except/no longer/at least/up to/rounding up|down/more than/higher than/instead/either) produced 24 flags, all of which I hand-checked and all of which are false positives from idiomatic renderings.
refuted_claims.evidence: ST-J05.cn.html: 'You or a nearby PC suffers a certain stress or panic response.' → '你或附近的 PC 承受了某些特定的压力反应或恐慌反应。'; Frenzy 'until you or the target is broken' → '直到你或目标濒死'; ST-I.cn.json Overkill 'when you or all enemies in sight are broken' → '当你或视野内所有敌人濒死时'. Idiomatic FPs: 'cannot' → 做不到/谈不拢/看不清/打不开/撑不住/盖不住; 'instead' → 而是/反而/改由/不如; 'never in an open zone' → 空旷区域里则不行.

refuted_claims.claim: Each unit obeyed the brief's rule 'use your proposal consistently — do NOT invent a second form' for the six unsettled life-cycle names.
refuted_claims.why_wrong: The assembled pack shipped three simultaneous Chinese words for Drone, two for Chestburster and two for Ovomorph. The rule was obeyed inside each unit and broken across the wave, which is exactly the gap no per-unit self-gate can see.
refuted_claims.evidence: Before fix — Drone: 工兵体 ×12 (ST-J07) vs 工蜂异形 ×22 (J08/J09/J10/J14/J15/J16/J21/J23) vs 独行异形 ×16 (ST-A-CRE, incl. the actor name '独行异形（第四阶段异形）'). Chestburster: 破胸体 ×34 (journals + ST-T-REST) vs 破胸虫 ×13 (ST-A-CRE). Ovomorph: 卵形体 (J07/J09/J22, and the J09 heading id="stage-i:-ovomorph-(egg)") vs 异形卵 (J08 link label + ST-A-CRE actor name) vs 外星卵 (J07 gloss).

refuted_claims.claim: 飞行官 (Officer), 杂工 (Roughneck) and 炫技 (Stunt) are unit-level wrong-sense errors of the 仅限通用汽车 / 选择消防员 class.
refuted_claims.why_wrong: All three are byte-exact matches to the shipped system lang file, i.e. the units did the right thing. The questionable choice lives in the LOCK, not in Phase 4, and cannot be repaired from here without a coordinated lang+pack commit.
refuted_claims.evidence: 1-系统汉化插件/lang/cn.json: ALIENRPG.Officer = 飞行官; ALIENRPG.Roughneck = 杂工; ALIENRPG.Stunts = 炫技; TYPES.Item.skill-stunts = 技能炫技. ST-A-CAST/ST-I/ST-J01 reproduce all three exactly.

refuted_claims.claim: ST-A-CRE's 接战距离 vs the journals' 紧邻距离 is a translation inconsistency in the pack.
refuted_claims.why_wrong: The two English sources genuinely differ — the Evolved journal rules say 'Adjacent range', the carried-over actor blurbs say 'Engaged Range' — and cn.json locks both words separately. The Chinese is faithful; the hazard is editorial, not a defect.
refuted_claims.evidence: 1-系统汉化插件/lang/cn.json line 73 "Adjacent": "紧邻距离", line 170 "Engaged": "接战". EN: ST-J04.en.html 'Close combat is any attack at Adjacent range'; raw-dumps/starterset.json Facehugger special 'may splash on its attacker and anyone within Engaged Range'.

refuted_claims.claim: 医务室 / 医疗实验室 / 医疗舱 is a three-way rendering of the same room.
refuted_claims.why_wrong: Three distinct English nouns, correctly kept distinct: Medbay (a ship sickbay in the USCSS Miranda worked example), Medlab (the Hadley's Hope laboratory) and MedPod (the Pauling surgical unit).
refuted_claims.evidence: ST-J03.en.html:255 'Hayes is in the Medbay' → 医务室; ST-J08.en.html:41 'Medlab' → 医疗实验室 (matches ST-U scene note 'Medlab': '医疗实验室'); ST-J08.en.html:100 'MedPod' → 医疗舱.

refuted_claims.claim: The read-aloud passages are where this pack is weakest and need the most repair (task item 1).
refuted_claims.why_wrong: The read-aloud is the pack's strongest prose. Of the ten evblockquoteCenter blocks in ST-J07..J10, only one (J07 #0, 'WHAT'S THE STORY MOTHER?') is spoken text; it survives being read aloud with no stacked pre-modifiers, no 被-chains, no 的-chains and no English clause order, and it correctly spells numbers out for speech. A heuristic scan for ≥3-的 chains and ≥2-被 long clauses over the whole pack returned zero true positives. The real damage is in the duplicated room descriptions and the actor/table units.
refuted_claims.evidence: ST-J07 #0: '危机归危机，活还是得干。' for 'Crisis or not, you have a job to do.'; '你们呼叫哈德利的希望，只换来一句敷衍——等着，等他们腾出手来，再管你们这点小麻烦。' for the cursory-response sentence; numbers spelled out (二十二年前 / 一百五十三 / 二十四小时前 / 十公里). J09 'Signing Off' radio message likewise reads cleanly. The other 9 blockquotes are GM-facing statblocks and rules boxes, correctly in flat rules register.

refuted_claims.claim: The Panic-response vocabulary given as 'just settled' (镇定·受惊·…) matches the LOCK byte-for-byte.
refuted_claims.why_wrong: It matches the shipped RollTable but not the lang key. Entry #1 disagrees: the lang file says 保持镇定, the settled list and ST-T-REUSE both say 镇定. Everything the pack does is internally right; the LOCK is the outlier and needs a ruling.
refuted_claims.evidence: 1-系统汉化插件/lang/cn.json ALIENRPG.Panic1 = '保持镇定：…'; 6-工作区/phase4-starterset/ST-T-REUSE.cn.json 'Panic Response Table' 0-0 name = '镇定'; ST-J05.cn.html '镇定。无效果。' All twelve other panic names (受惊/喧闹/躁动/脱手/猜忌/犹豫/怔住/掩蔽/尖叫/逃跑/发狂/木僵) match across all three artefacts.

Files: pages/ST-J09.cn.html, pages/ST-J10.cn.html

ST-J10: 'an Impaled Thigh critical injury' → “大腿被刺穿”重伤 (was 大腿贯穿伤). Evidence — ST-T-CRIT.cn.json 'EV - Critical Injuries' 25-25 伤势: 大腿被刺穿. This is a live cross-reference: the attack tells the GM to apply a named row of that table. File: pages/ST-J10.cn.html

ST-J10 + ST-J09: 'Imp' 小鬼异形 → 幼魔 and 'Silent Assassin' 无声杀手 → 无声刺客; ST-J09 'Containment & Termination Protocol' 收容与终止协议 → 收容与终结规程. ST-I.cn.json + ST-A-CAST.cn.json: Overkill talent — 'you must attack your enemies on every turn' was 你每一节都必须攻击敌人; corrected to 你每个回合都必须攻击敌人 in both copies. Evidence — 节 is the Stretch time unit (pages/ST-J03.cn.html time table: Stretch 节 / 5–10 分钟), while turn is 回合 (ST-J03: '你在先攻顺序中的位置称为你的回合'). As written the talent forced an attack once per 5–10 minutes instead of once per initiative turn. Same edit also changed ST-I's 不能掩蔽 → 不能寻找掩护, because 掩蔽 is the locked name of the panic response Seek Cover (cn.json ALIENRPG.Panic11).

ST-A-CAST.cn.json: Cutting Torch — 'Power Supply 5' / 'Power Supply roll' / 'Power Supply level of 5' were 电力供应 5 / 电力供应检定 / 电力供应等级为 5; corrected to 电量 5 / 电力余量检定 / 电量为 5. Evidence — Supply is the game's remaining-charge mechanic: cn.json ALIENRPG.Supply = 余量检定, and pages/ST-J02.cn.html defines it as '它们统称为余量… 余量检定'. 供应 is the everyday sense of the word — the same failure class as 仅限通用汽车.

ST-I.cn.json: four agenda cards had 'crew' rendered as ship's crew in a scenario with no ship. SIGG-ACT2 船上其他人总该明白这一点吧？ → 队里其他人…; HIRSCH-ACT3 你船员的性命 → 你队友的性命; HOLROYD-ACT1 保住其他船员的命 → 保住其他队友的命; HOLROYD-ACT2 可要是船员们发现 → 可要是队友们发现. Evidence — the PCs are a Hadley's Hope survey team walking back overland; the only ship in the pack is the Starcub shuttle they have not reached. (The 船员/船上/船友 uses in ST-J02/J03/J05 are correct — those worked examples are aboard the USCSS Miranda and were left alone.)

Was '压力等级 会在你每一次于一节 潜行模式 中移动、或经过一轮战斗（战斗与先攻）时上升一级' — the second half dropped the movement condition, so stress would rise every combat round whether or not the character moved. Now '…中移动、或在一轮战斗（战斗与先攻 ）中移动时上升一级'. Evidence — EN: 'your Stress Level increases one step every time you move in a stretch of STEALTH MODE or a round of combat'. verdict:
The prose itself is good — better than the mechanics of assembling it. Sentence-level translation quality is high: the read-aloud intro works spoken, the rules text in ST-J02..J06 is precise and flat, negations and disjunctions all survive (24 audit flags, all false positives), no number is lost once Chinese numerals are folded, and a heuristic scan for 的-chains and 被-chains over the whole pack returned zero true positives. The register is correct per unit: rules flat, scenario tense, boxed text speakable.

What failed is the wave, not the writing. Every serious defect I found is a seam between units that no per-unit self-gate could see. The worst: the Xenomorph Drone shipped under three different Chinese names simultaneously (工兵体 in ST-J07, 工蜂异形 in eight journal units, 独行异形 as the actor's own name in ST-A-CRE), and Chestburster and Ovomorph under two each — the actor a GM drags onto the map did not share a name with the creature the scenario text describes. Ten Xenomorph signature-attack names differed between the journal page a GM reads and the RollTable that fires in chat. Two deep links pointed at headings with different names than their own labels. Thirty blocks of identical English were translated twice by different units. I fixed roughly 130 strings across 18 files and re-verified markup, JSON, links and numbers clean.

Three real content errors, all outside the read-aloud: the Overkill talent made you attack once per 节 (5–10 minutes) instead of once per 回合; the Cutting Torch used 电力供应 for the Supply mechanic, which the LOCK calls 余量; and ST-J02's encumbrance rule dropped the movement condition from the combat half of "every time you move in a stretch of stealth mode or a round of combat". The pregen relationship web, which the task suspected, is intact — 4/4 surnames resolve.

Two things need the controller, not me. The four life-cycle names are still `pending` in the glossary while ~50 strings and three actor names now depend on my standardisation — pin them in RESOLUTIONS before anything else references them. And the acid-splash armour-degradation sentence in ST-J09 narrows "each point of damage" to damage absorbed by armour; both English readings are live and it is the pack's most load-bearing creature rule, so it wants a ruling rather than a unilateral edit.
